CLIP DESCRIPTION:
Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) leads an escape from the Death Eaters with the assistance of Dobby the House Elf (Toby Jones).

FILM DESCRIPTION:
The first installment of the two-film adaptation of Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows follows Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), Ron (Rupert Grint), and Hermione (Emma Watson) as they search for the pieces of Voldemort's (Ralph Fiennes) soul that he extracted from his being and hid in obscure locations both far and wide. If the trio is unable to locate and destroy them all, Voldemort will remain immortal. Despite their long friendship, a combination of dark forces, romantic tensions, and long-held secrets threaten to sabotage the mission. David Yates directs.

snippet.title: Ron/Hermione Ҩ Where Are You? I Need You... Ҩ [{Malfoy Manor]}
snippet.description:
This is the result of being too sick to get off the couch yesterday.  Before you waste my time with dumb questions: YES, that IS Rupert Grint at 0:57 screaming "Let her go! Hermione! Hermioneeeee!"  I recorded some audio from my friend's Deathly Hallows video game. 

...So if you're one of those who wanted Ron to freak out more while Hermione was tortured, there you go. 

It's just basically Hermione's thoughts while at Malfoy Manor, a bit of Ron's, too. 

I'm really happy with how this turned out, hence not waiting till next weekend to upload this. (: 

Haunted by Kelly Clarkson  (slowed down and pitched)
I love the coloring. =D It was a pain to make, so you better love it, too. Heehe. I kid. Mostly.
